'''Justin Anselmi''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Anselmi was born on September 18, 1984, in Paola, Kansas. As an adult, he became an actor, getting only minor roles in lesser-known films and TV shows. He eventually joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}. Several of the roles Anselmi has taken on were previously voiced by [[Tom Wayland]].
